source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Identify the emission sources.
3. Compare emissions with legal limits and standards.
4. Document all incidents of exceeding these limits.
5. Capture accurate time frames and duration.
6. Include exact measurements and units.
7. Record weather conditions.
8. Attach any related photographs or video evidence.
9. Describe the measurement equipment used.
10. Include calibration records for all equipment.
11. Report any maintenance or malfunction of monitoring equipment.
12. Mention any method used to calculate estimates when direct measurements were not possible.
13. Record any mitigation actions taken by the industry in response.
14. Document any communications with the regulator or industrial facility.
15. Itemize any impact on surrounding communities or ecosystems.
16. Provide data analysis and commentary.
17. State the potential health and environmental risks associated with the excessive emissions.
18. Use maps and diagrams to illustrate the emission sources and affected areas.
19. Note any inconsistencies or anomalies.
20. Sign and date the report
